resources.name: Open-source DFT package (e.g., ORCA, NWChem, PySCF)

access.notes: Any DFT code supporting B3LYP and the required basis sets. The agent must install it.

resources.name: Wachter's all-electron basis set for Fe

access.notes: Basis set parameters for Fe (contracted 62111111/3311111/3111) plus one polarization function. Available in many DFT program libraries or can be manually implemented.
α = -0.395 mm s⁻¹ au³ and ρ₀^S = 11614.10 au⁻³. These values are stated in the paper and derived from previous works.
